title: PM ↔ Eng Lead 1:1 prep - API / Console / Dedicated / Private
content:
Goal for this 1:1: sync on priorities for next 6 weeks across API, Console, Dedicated capacity, and Private deployment path; unblock engineering staffing and rollout dependencies; align on risk and communication plan for the Console feature flags rollout.

Top-line agenda (30–40 min)
- Quick sync (5): personal, context, any hot outages or escalations to flag.
- API surface work (10): review /batching and streaming changes, perf numbers, migration plan for clients that depend on old streaming tokens.
- Console + Rollouts (10): canary plan, telemetry gaps, UX blocker list.
- Dedicated & Private (10): capacity forecast, gating criteria for customer onboarding, security/KMS items.
- Action items + next steps (5).

Notes / talking points
1) API: batching/streaming changes
- Perf: internal bench shows 12–18% p99 token latency improvement with continuous batching enabled on dedicated nodes. Metrics are from infra-runner-a / experimental profile. Need to sanity-check on real traffic.
- Migration concerns: some SDK users rely on current streaming event shapes. Risk: changing streaming framing will break streaming parsers used by several customers.
- Proposal: behind a feature flag for 2 weeks, default off for existing tenants, on for new tenants. Roll forward when telemetry stable.
- Ask for eng: estimate for compatibility shim (to support old framing for 2 weeks) -> Samir to quick-scope.

2) Console + Rollouts
- Canary strategy: target 5% of traffic for canary across 2 regions (us-west1/us-east1). Need routing policy changes in router service.
- Telemetry gaps: we currently don't tag tokens with rollout-id at the trace-level; makes rollback decision slower. Need a light instrumentation change (trace + console metrics).
- UX blocker: the "pin version" dialog currently allows selection of deprecated quantization profiles; product wants to hide deprecated ones. This is small but important for customer trust.
- Communication: internal doc + #console-release channel. Draft message to CSMs once canary stable.

3) Dedicated & Private
- Capacity: sales asked for onboarding 3 mid-market customers this quarter. We need a clear SLA for Dedicated onboarding time (target 10 business days after paperwork). Ops estimate currently 18 days.
- Private: KMS integration testing still has edge-cases (HSM key rotation sim). Security team flagged audit log gap for on-prem install flow.
- Gating criteria suggestion: require end-to-end KMS rotation test and audit-log validation before any customer is marked "private-ready". Ops to own checklist.

Open questions to raise in 1:1
- Are we comfortable with the feature-flag-first approach for streaming? How long should the default on/off window be?
- Do we have runway (headcount) to implement the telemetry change before canary? If not, what's the minimal rollback plan?
- For Dedicated onboarding SLA: do we push to sales a conservative date now or pause customers until ops backlog reduces?

Action items (owner - due)
- Samir K.: scope compatibility shim for streaming framing and provide rough ETA (3d) - due 2026-03-03.
- Daniel R.: draft canary/rollback playbook + customer communication draft for CSMs (1 week) - due 2026-03-06.
- Alicia C.: add rollout-id tagging to trace instrumentation and top-level console metrics; quick PR to add feature flag gating (estimate 5d) - due 2026-03-10.
- Ops (Ben, cc'd): produce Dedicated onboarding checklist and target timeline; include KMS rotation test steps - due 2026-03-12.
- Product / UX: hide deprecated quantization profiles from "pin version" selector; quick patch (2d) - due 2026-03-04.

Follow-ups (items to surface in next 1:1)
- Telemetry results from canary (p75/p95/p99, error rates, token cost delta).
- Final decision on default for streaming feature flag after compatibility shim ETA.
- Ops progress on Dedicated onboarding timeline and any blocker requiring engineering support.

Scratch notes / fragments to capture
- Could try a progressive migration for streaming: server emits both frames for 48 hours, client opt-in header to switch. Might be heavier but smoother.
- Need to document which customers are on legacy streaming parsers (CS has list; request from Samir).
- Consider adding a "rollout-id" header that both router and runtime can copy to traces for easier correlation.

Links & refs (quick)
- Confluence: console-rollouts (CON-3422) - draft playbook
- JIRA: INF-1187 - streaming framing change
- GH: console frontend PR #432 (pin dialog)

Tone: keep conservative risk posture for public API changes, move faster on Console UX fixes, treat Dedicated onboarding as ops-led but eng-supported.

Endnotes: remind to block 1 hour with CSM lead after canary green to coordinate customer comms.
plaintext_preview: Goal: align on API/Console/Dedicated/Private priorities; actions: scope shim, telemetry, canary playbook, ops checklist.
